title: Our Forest
text:
Trees are very important. They give us fresh air and shade. Many birds live in trees. Animals find food and homes there.

The forest is a good place for people too. Children can walk and play under the big trees. Please do not throw trash on the ground. Keep the forest clean.

questions.text: What can children do in the forest?
options: Walk and play under the big trees

questions.text: Why should people keep the forest clean?
options: Because birds and animals live there
Because the forest is far away

questions.text: What does the writer think about the forest?
options: It is important and should be protected

vocabulary.definition: clean and cool, with no bad smell
a dark place where the sun does not shine directly
the places where people or animals live

paragraph_translations: Ağaçlar çok önemlidir. Bize temiz hava ve gölge verirler. Ağaçlarda birçok kuş yaşar. Hayvanlar orada yiyecek ve evler bulur.
Orman insanlar için de güzel bir yerdir. Çocuklar büyük ağaçların altında yürüyüp oynayabilir. Lütfen yere çöp atmayın. Ormanı temiz tutun.
